text: The Patriots face a significant challenge heading into Sunday's 1 PM ET home opener against the Steelers at Gillette Stadium, as wide receiver A.J. Brown has been placed on injured reserve following a high ankle sprain suffered in Week 1, forcing him to miss at least four games and prompting questions about who will step up in his absence—though the team will look to bounce back with Drake Maye under center, the same quarterback who this week demonstrated his character by joining his wife Ann Michael in surprising over 50 teachers and support staff at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence with a generous Amazon wish list donation. Head Coach Mike Vrabel addressed the team's preparations at his Wednesday press conference, while the organization also made headlines off the field when owner Robert Kraft had rapper Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming Gillette Stadium shows, citing a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."
